title: CLI reference prose overlay
description: Structured LLM/agent input for reference-prose/<slug>.md. Facts (flags, exit codes) stay in reference-raw/; only narrative fields belong here.

overview.description: 1–2 sentences: what the command is and does. Lead with value, not mechanism.

whenToUse.description: Short guidance paragraph. Do not include the **When to use it:** label — compile adds it.

notes.description: Optional 1–3 sentences on a key gotcha (disk effects, critical mode). Omit when nothing earns its place.
